Paediatric endocrinologist
Main areas of specialisation:

  • Treatment of diabetes
  • Treatment of endocrine disorders

Summary:
Dr Asaf Oren is a paediatric endocrinologist and one of Israel's most experienced and sought-after specialists in the diagnosis and treatment of a wide range of endocrine disorders in children, of hormonal imbalances, and of diabetes and obesity in children and adolescents. He is senior endocrinologist in the department for the treatment of endocrine disorders and diabetes at a children's hospital. He also gives consultations on childhood illnesses, including allergic and infectious diseases.

Dr Oren is known well beyond Israel for his professionalism and his attentive care for the health of young patients. He has some 15 years of experience. He favours a multidisciplinary approach and the combination of different treatment methods in the therapy of endocrine disorders.

Alongside his daily clinical practice, Asaf Oren is actively engaged in academic work. He is a well-known and much sought-after lecturer and has organised seminars in endocrinology for students at the medical university in Toronto. He currently lectures at the Sheinborn School of Nursing to students and to nurses taking advanced courses in neonatal intensive care in Tel Aviv. He also teaches paediatrics in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University.

Together with colleagues, Dr Asaf Oren has published more than 20 research papers on paediatric endocrinology.

Education:

  • Faculty of Medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel
  • Fellowship in the paediatric department of The Hospital for Sick Children, Toronto, Canada
  • Fellowship in endocrinology in the unit for diabetes and endocrine disorders at the Dana-Dwek children's hospital, Sourasky medical centre, Tel Aviv, Israel

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Endocrine Society
  • Israel Society for Paediatric Endocrinology

Specialisation:

  • Dermatology
  • Aesthetic skin surgery
  • Dermatological surgery

Summary: Dr Baruch Kaplan is a leading specialist in dermatology and dermatological surgery, with more than 27 years of clinical practice. Dr Kaplan specialises in treating skin conditions, performing aesthetic procedures and carrying out dermatological surgery. His professional path began with a medical degree from the faculty of medicine at Ben-Gurion University of the Negev in 1985. He then specialised in dermatology and dermatological surgery at the Tel HaShomer medical centre, Israel.

Dr Kaplan trained in surgery and in Mohs micrographic surgery under Dr Ronald L. Moy at the University of California, Los Angeles, USA. His professional experience and high level of qualification have made him a sought-after specialist both in Israel and abroad. Dr Kaplan takes an active part in scientific and clinical conferences, including the annual meeting of the American Academy of Dermatology.

Dr Kaplan has received several awards for research in skin cancer and aesthetic procedures. He is a member of several prestigious professional associations, which confirms his standing and recognition in the medical community.

Education:

  • Medical degree from the faculty of medicine, Ben-Gurion University of the Negev, Beersheba, 1985
  • Specialisation in dermatology and dermatological surgery at the Tel HaShomer medical centre, Israel
  • Fellowship in surgery and Mohs micrographic surgery under Dr Ronald L. Moy at the University of California, Los Angeles, USA

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Clinical and academic experience:

  • More than 27 years of clinical practice
  • Several awards for research in skin cancer and aesthetic procedures
  • Participant in many scientific and clinical conferences in Israel and abroad, including the annual meeting of the American Academy of Dermatology

Membership of associations:

  • American College of Mohs Surgery
  • American Society for Dermatologic Surgery
  • American Academy of Dermatology
  • Israel Society of Dermatology
  • Israel Society of Dermatologic Surgery

Otolaryngologist

Main areas of specialisation

  • Endoscopic operations on the sinuses
  • Surgical treatment of the tonsils
  • Operations on the thyroid and parathyroid glands
  • Cancer surgery of the scalp, neck and salivary glands
  • Treatment of conditions of the vocal cords, including malignant ones

Summary

Dr Dan Gutman is a highly qualified Israeli ENT surgeon with 24 years of experience. He is currently a senior physician at the Assuta clinic and heads its department for the surgical treatment of head and neck tumours.

Dr Gutman's main specialisation is ENT surgery. He is skilled in a range of otolaryngological operations and places particular emphasis on minimally invasive interventions. His professional interests also include the treatment of various conditions of the vocal cords, including malignant ones.

Education and clinical experience

  • 2016: Head of the department for the surgical treatment of head and neck tumours, Assuta medical centre
  • 2014: Deputy head of the head and neck surgery department, Meir clinic
  • 2005: Fellowship in head and neck surgery and microsurgery at the Charité hospital, Berlin
  • 2004: Senior physician, otolaryngology department, Beilinson hospital
  • 2003: Fellowship in head and neck surgery at the Beilinson clinic (Rabin Medical Centre)
  • 1996: Medical degree from the Technion, Haifa, Israel

Academic and research work

Dr Dan Gutman teaches in the Sackler Faculty of Medicine at Tel Aviv University. He maintains research links with colleagues in Israel and other countries.

Membership of medical associations

Dr Gutman is a member of the Israel Society of ENT Physicians and of the Israel Society for Head and Neck Cancer Surgery and Treatment, and also runs a forum on ENT conditions on the Ynet website.

Summary: Dr David Sarid is a leading oncologist in Israel, a doctor of international standing and a specialist in chemotherapy and radiotherapy. He is an expert of world class who applies the most modern methods to the treatment of all forms of cancer and of metastatic disease.

Dr Sarid specialises in the diagnosis and treatment of a wide range of cancers: cancer of the breast, of the uterus and its appendages, of the prostate, of the digestive tract, of the lungs, of the kidney and bladder, and growths on the skin. His professional interests include chemotherapy, radiotherapy, biological cancer therapy, and the rehabilitation of patients after treatment. He has more than 30 years of clinical experience.

An excellent diagnostician, Dr Sarid combines many years of professional experience with the highest level of skill, which allows him to give effective help each year to thousands of patients from almost every country. His fluent Russian gives patients from the former Soviet states the added opportunity of closer contact, and of discussing every detail of the proposed treatment and its possible consequences.

David Sarid is also a much sought-after teacher, lecturing to students in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University and to colleagues on continuing professional development courses. He has been awarded a prize for the best academic lecture.

Alongside his clinical and teaching work, Dr Sarid is actively engaged in research. He regularly presents the results of his clinical investigations at international oncology congresses and conferences. He is the author of 30 research publications in leading professional medical journals.

David Sarid is a recognised specialist who enjoys well-deserved respect among colleagues not only in Israel but far beyond it. His expert opinion is valued highly by oncologists internationally.

Education:

  • Faculty of Medicine, Tbilisi University, Georgia
  • Fellowship in internal medicine at the Kakhiani hospital, Georgia
  • Fellowship in oncology at the Sourasky medical centre, Tel Aviv, Israel
  • Fellowship in uro-oncology and in the treatment of prostate cancer at the University of Oxford, England

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Russian

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Medical Association (IMA)
  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiation Therapy (ISCORT)
  • European Society for Medical Oncology (ESMO)
  • American Society of Clinical Oncology (ASCO)

Surgeon, thoracic and cardiac surgeon

MAIN AREAS OF SPECIALISATION

  • Cardiac surgery
  • Thoracic surgery

THE DOCTOR'S SPECIALISATION

Dr David Simansky is one of Israel's leading thoracic and cardiac surgeons and specialises in thoracoscopic operations using the most modern medical video systems.

CONDITIONS TREATED

  • Congenital heart defects
  • Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy
  • Coronary artery disease
  • Thymic cancer
  • Hybrid operating theatre
  • Endoscopic operations

SUMMARY

Dr David Simansky is a recognised expert in thoracic and cardiac surgery. He has deep knowledge and extensive experience in performing the most complex operations on the heart and chest. In his practice he uses advanced technologies and treatment methods, which allows him to achieve excellent results and to minimise risk for patients. Dr Simansky is actively engaged in research and constantly refines his skills by taking part in international conferences and symposia.

EDUCATION AND CLINICAL EXPERIENCE

  • Faculty of Medicine, Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel
  • Deputy head of the chest surgery department at the Sheba medical centre (Tel HaShomer, Israel)

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Medical Association
  • Israel Society of Cardiac Surgeons
  • European Association for Cardio-Thoracic Surgery
  • International society of cardiac surgery

Dr David Simansky is a name associated with the highest standards of quality in medicine and surgery. Patients from around the world entrust their lives to him, knowing that they will receive the best treatment and care.

Radiologist
Experience: 40 years

Specialisation

Dr Diana Matceyevsky is a leading Israeli oncologist. Her professional standing brings many patients from abroad who come specifically to consult her. At the Assuta clinic, where she practises regularly, she oversees general oncology and works in radiation therapy. The main areas of her work include the diagnosis and treatment of:

  • Cancer of the lip
  • Cancer of the throat
  • Brain cancer
  • Cancer of the uterus
  • Liver cancer
  • Stomach cancer
  • Ovarian cancer
  • Cancer of the oral cavity
  • Cervical cancer
  • Breast cancer
  • Thyroid cancer
  • Pancreatic cancer

Education and clinical experience

  • 2021: Named among the best doctors by Forbes Israel
  • 2003: Private practice at the Assuta medical centre
  • 2001: Senior physician at the Institute of Oncology, Ichilov clinic
  • 1992: Physician, Institute of Oncology, Ichilov-Sourasky medical centre
  • 1992: Licence to practise medicine in Israel
  • 1988: Oncological surgeon at the Basin hospital, Riga
  • 1987: Residency in oncology, Riga Medical Institute
  • 1968: Riga Medical Institute, Latvia — graduated from the faculty of medicine and then completed an internship in general surgery

Academic and research work

Diana Matceyevsky took her medical degree and her first residency in oncology at the Riga Medical Institute in Latvia. Some time later she completed advanced training courses at the Latvian Medical Academy.

After several years working as an oncological surgeon at the Latvian Republican Oncology Centre, Dr Matceyevsky was sent to specialise in the oncology department of the large Israeli medical centre Ichilov-Sourasky. On completing it she was offered a post at the National Oncology Institute based at the Assuta medical centre.

Her next placement was in the geriatric oncology department of the European School of Oncology, followed by advanced courses in the postgraduate education department of the National Oncology Institute.

By that time she was already working as a senior physician in the oncology department at Assuta, where she continues to work today.

Dr Matceyevsky's research is published regularly in medical journals. Her best-known papers have described:

  • Neoadjuvant chemotherapy and radiotherapy in advanced pancreatic cancer
  • Dead Sea products that reduce the side effects of radiotherapy in patients with head and neck tumours
  • Reducing cardiac toxicity in patients with left-sided breast cancer

Her papers on gemcitabine in the treatment of recurrent epithelial ovarian cancer, and on targeted therapy with inhaled interleukin-2 for pulmonary metastases of renal cell carcinoma, drew a lively response from professionals.

Membership of medical associations

  • Israel Society of Clinical Oncology and Radiation Therapy
  • Israel Breast Cancer Society
  • Society of Gynaecological Oncology
